title: Engineering Technician
abstract: Gain specialist technical skills in a hands-on field role involving laser scanning, geotechnical testing and engineering data collection.
bullets: Hands on role using advanced laser scanning technology
Full training provided with opportunity for further study
Travel to mining and industrial sites across Queensland
content_text:
Find your fit at FIELD Engineers
At FIELD Engineers, we don’t just offer jobs. We offer careers where you can grow, thrive and find purpose. We’re a small consulting engineering firm with a big reputation and even bigger ambitions. Whether you’re just starting your career or have some experience up your sleeve and looking for a new challenge, we’ll help you find your fit with us.
Your opportunity at FIELD
Based in Mackay, you'll work alongside experienced engineers and technicians, collecting accurate site data that supports engineering design, analysis and project delivery.
You'll visit sites across Queensland, using specialist equipment to undertake laser scanning, laser tracking, plate load bearing testing and other field measurement activities.
This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys being out on site rather than behind a desk. You'll spend time working outdoors, setting up and operating equipment, and working as part of a team to deliver practical outcomes for our clients. The role involves regular travel throughout Queensland, including overnight stays in camp accommodation when required.
Full training will be provided, making this an excellent opportunity for an engineering student, graduate engineer or engineering technician looking to develop specialist technical skills in a growing field.
You’ll be exposed to diverse projects with opportunities to develop your skills and experience across a range of industries. At FIELD Engineers, you’ll never be pigeonholed. There’s always something new to learn, and you’ll be encouraged to take ownership of your work from day one.
What you’ll bring
We're looking for someone who enjoys practical work, takes pride in doing a job well and is keen to develop specialist technical skills. You will bring:
 - Qualifications (currently studying towards, or have completed, a qualification in Engineering, Engineering Technology or a related discipline). 
 - A current Queensland driver's licence. 
 - A positive attitude and strong work ethic. 
 - An interest in practical, field-based engineering work. 
 - A willingness to learn new technologies and develop specialist technical skills. 
 - Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate results. 
 - The physical capability to work outdoors and carry equipment on site.
 - Ability to travel and stay away from home when required.
Why FIELD Engineers?
At FIELD, you’ll work in a practical, people-focused business where your contribution genuinely matters. You’ll find:
 - People who care - A supportive, down-to-earth team that values collaboration, respect and open communication.
 - Trust and growth - Real ownership of your role, with the support and opportunity to develop your skills alongside experienced professionals.
 - Challenge and pride - Interesting work that builds your skills and gives you pride in what you achieve.
 - Balance that's right - Through flexibility and trust, we help you find the right balance between work and life.
Ready to find your fit at FIELD?
We’ll start shortlisting and interviewing as applications come in, so don’t wait. Apply now! Send us your resume and a cover letter telling us why this job is right for you.
For more information, contact Moyea Maclean, our HR Manager, on 0428 946 458.
At FIELD Engineers, we celebrate diversity and recognise that varied perspectives drive innovation and creativity. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, as each unique contribution enriches our team.
